name: Fernwood Designs Woodworking
old_description: Located in the Blue Ridge Mountains of  Western North Carolina, Rich Grenier is the owner/creator of Fernwood Designs.  His shop is tucked away on a peaceful parcel of land where he lives with his wife and artist
about:
Fernwood Designs operates from a woodworking shop in Mars Hill, North Carolina, nestled in the Blue Ridge Mountains of Western North Carolina. Owner and creator Rich Grenier runs the business with his wife, artist Francine D’Antuono, from a property where a path through the woods leads to the shop and provides daily inspiration. The company’s founding year is not publicly stated.

The shop is equipped for a range of custom woodwork: cabinetry, furniture spanning farmhouse rustic to refined urban styles, counter and table tops, built-in units, tongue-and-groove milling for flooring and ceilings, lathe-turned legs and trim, milling and sanding of raw lumber up to 50 inches wide, epoxy and stone inlays, fine art frames, interior and exterior doors, and trim and moulding. Francine D’Antuono contributes design services, producing detailed drawings and plans for projects from full kitchens to single pieces.

Fernwood Designs serves clients seeking custom cabinetry, furniture, architectural millwork, and artistic wood pieces. The company works with a wide variety of wood species, from exotic lumbers to reclaimed boards salvaged from old structures, treating each piece as a unique work of art.

Rich Grenier emphasizes preserving the natural character of each wood selection, assembling pieces to keep the material’s unique qualities true. The collaborative design process, combining Rich’s craftsmanship with Francine’s artistic drawings, is presented as a core differentiator for the business.
